rule: An external dependency is not a substitute for unfinished local code. No dependency is reported as configured or tested live without observed evidence.

dependencies.impact: Verification, reset, email change and invitation delivery cannot be claimed from a local outbox.
dependencies.minimum_configuration: Existing authorized transactional email adapter, sender/domain configuration, private credentials and delivery/error policy.
dependencies.local_work_required: Persistent purpose-bound single-use hashed tokens, TTL/rate limiting, revocation, server authorization, test-only outbox and honest unavailable states.
dependencies.missing_evidence: Authorized configured adapter and delivery/operational evidence. This task does not send real messages to third parties.

dependencies.impact: No real subscription payment, checkout, invoice or customer portal can be advertised as operational.
dependencies.minimum_configuration: Approved existing provider/contract, real plan/entitlement configuration and private webhook signing key.
dependencies.local_work_required: Organization entitlements distinct from membership/Hermes usage budget; signed, deduplicated, ordered event contract with deterministic tests; disabled checkout without provider.
dependencies.missing_evidence: Approved provider contract/configuration and authorized integration evidence; no charge or invented price/trial.

dependencies.impact: A new company must remain disconnected rather than inherit FINANCE_PROFILE or the legacy store credentials.
dependencies.minimum_configuration: Authorized provider app/scopes, per-company/store connection registration, protected credentials and bound one-use OAuth state.
dependencies.local_work_required: Server membership/store/capability checks, scoped repositories, trusted service envelope, strict routing and cross-company state/reconnection tests.
dependencies.missing_evidence: Authorized real connector configuration by company and verified scopes. Existing legacy connection is not evidence of generalized tenancy.

dependencies.impact: Do not claim legal compliance or enable irreversible purge without an applicable retention policy.
dependencies.minimum_configuration: Approved document versions, retention/deletion policy and responsibility for public commercial offering.
dependencies.local_work_required: Authenticated export/request/offboarding contracts, reauth, explicit consequences, preservation of business audit and isolation tests.
dependencies.missing_evidence: Approved applicable policy/documents; implementation must not invent legal text.

dependencies.impact: Synthetic QA and Live availability cannot close M2/M2.2 or prove completeness of bank/Seller Centre data, actual manufacturing or realized profit.
dependencies.minimum_configuration: Authorized owner session and the appropriate real operational evidence when a later acceptance exercise is requested.
dependencies.local_work_required: Preserve pending/unknown states, source periods/revisions, comparison contracts and honest release documentation.
dependencies.missing_evidence: Requirement-specific authorized operational comparison. No real facts are created for QA.

intentional_domain_gates: Ads/PROMO and external commercial writes remain locked for every role.
Hermes remains an observer; agent memory grants no authority or model training.
Seven specialist chart slots without canonical sources remain unavailable.
TikTok/Mercado Livre and unsupported import formats are not activated by the redesign.
New multi-company access is not enabled until local isolation, migrations, recovery and runtime configuration are verified.
